name: IEEE Symposium Series on Computational Intelligence
welcomeTitle: Welcome to Gold Coast, Australia, IEEE SSCI 2027
welcomeBody: IEEE SSCI 2027 is proposed as an in-person conference on the Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia, with hybrid presentation support available if needed.
The conference will bring together researchers, practitioners, industry leaders, government partners, and students working across the broad field of computational intelligence.
Program details, speakers, registration information, sponsors, and local arrangements will continue to be updated as they are confirmed.
